typePromptPrefixes.ui: Pure action-card artwork rule: full-bleed vertical illustration for a game card, dense integrated composition from edge to edge, no title bar, no footer bar, no blank label zones, no reward placeholder area, no empty UI slots, no framed template layout. Fill the whole canvas with artwork, texture, props, motion, and atmosphere. The generated image itself must contain no typography, no symbols that look like text, no digits.
